cases.title: EvoMap Evolver — OpenClaw Local Self-Evolution Smoke Test v0
cases.category: AI agent self-evolution / experience reuse / local agent workflow
cases.local_role: Install and run @evomap/evolver locally; create failure-log fixtures; run evolver run+review with Hub disabled; evaluate whether generated repair prompts are useful for OpenClaw / Hermes / Codex workflows.
cases.cloud_role: Not used in this phase. EvoMap Hub connection, auto-publish, validator, ATP autobuy, and credits are disabled.
cases.summary: ATL-EVOMAP-5 local evolution kit PASS: productized the local-only Gene+Capsule pathway from Phases 4A/4B/4C as a reusable stdlib-only toolset; delivered canonical bundle atl-evomap-portable-bundle-v0.1 (openclaw-tool-use-discipline, 5458 bytes, sourced from Phase 4C PASS at f7897da); 3 stdlib tools (evomap_inspect_bundle.py 2674B / evomap_validate_bundle.py 6817B with 12 checks + secret scan / evomap_apply_bundle.py 8869B with --dry-run default + --yes for real write, idempotent on gene/capsule by id, append-only on memory_graph); 3 templates (GENE / CAPSULE / MEMORY_GRAPH_SIGNAL) for new bundles; 4-step recipe (validate -> inspect -> dry-run -> apply --yes -> manual evolver); self-tests: inspect PASS, validate 12/12 PASS, apply dry-run PASS (0 files written), apply --yes PASS (6 files written to /tmp/atl-evomap-phase5-apply-target, 1 gene + 1 capsule + 5 clean bare memory signals); idempotency verified; all 16 hard boundaries preserved by tool design (no Hub / no publish / no credits / no validator / no --approve / no solidify / no real config mutation / no secrets / no source modification / no isolated runtime committed / stdlib only); ATL-EVOMAP exploration series complete (3C-V2 blocked -> 4A PASS -> 4B PASS -> 4C PASS -> 5 PASS); kit is durable asset for future OpenClaw/Hermes/Codex local evolution work.

detector emits 5/5 on fixture, 3/5 on real artifact; injection read by evolver scanner; selector picks gene_tool_integrity (local bank) NOT new Gene due to qualified→bare strip
